title: Query Complexity Analysis
description: Limit expensive queries with complexity analysis.

data.text: GraphQL's flexibility is also its danger: a client can request deeply nested data in a single query, overwhelming your server. Query complexity analysis limits how "expensive" a query can be.
Each field is assigned a complexity score. Hot Chocolate sums the scores and rejects queries that exceed a configurable maximum.

data.title: Configure Complexity
data.content: Set max complexity and field costs.

data.text: A query that fetches 10 books, each with 5 reviews, scores: 10 * (1 + 20) = 210. If the limit is 100, the query is rejected.

data.title: Complex Query
data.content: This query exceeds the complexity limit.

data.title: Choosing Limits
data.text: Start with a high limit during development, then lower it based on real query analysis. Hot Chocolate returns the complexity score in error messages for debugging.

terms.definition: A numerical score representing the computational cost of a GraphQL query.
The maximum allowed complexity score for a single query.
The complexity contribution of a single field in the schema.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Assign costs to fields based on DB work
Reject queries that exceed the limit
